sourcesIntro: Device and component data in this app comes from TechAPI. It is licensed CC-BY-SA 4.0, so it must be attributed and shared under the same terms.
sourcesPerDevice: Per-device sources are listed at the bottom of each detail screen.
laptopNote: No index — TechAPI carries no laptop benchmarks. Sorted by price, highest first.
buildUseGamingSub: Frame rates ride on the GPU. For the CPU, single-core matters more.
buildUseCreatorSub: Leans on GPU acceleration and CPU multi-core together. Either one alone is wasted.
buildUseOfficeSub: Build times and responsiveness come from the CPU. A discrete GPU is optional.
buildUseAiSub: VRAM decides whether a model fits at all. Compute comes second.
buildEmpty: No pair fits this budget. Try raising it.
buildReq: What the rest has to be
buildReqNoIgpu: None — a discrete GPU is required
buildBottleneckCpu: The CPU cannot keep the GPU fed (index gap {}). Move up a CPU, or down a GPU.
buildBottleneckGpu: The GPU is weak next to the CPU (index gap {}). Move up a GPU if graphics work matters.
buildScope: TechAPI carries no motherboards, memory, storage, power supplies or cases. Only the CPU and GPU are real products here, and the budget is those two list prices — not the price of a finished machine.
buildPsuNote: The recommended wattage adds the CPU's peak draw, the GPU's draw, and {}W for the board, memory, storage and fans, rounded up to the next 50W.
